"""Three direct choices -> verified native Home profile save, always opt-in."""
import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
from localization import tr
KINDS=((32401,'live'),(32403,'vod'),(32404,'series'))
ERRORS={'PROFILE_BUDGET','INVALID_SOURCE','SINGLE_WIDGET_HOME','UNVERIFIED_SKIN_VERSION','UNVERIFIED_SHORTCUTS_VERSION','UNSUPPORTED_SKIN','PLAYER_ACTIVE','NATIVE_EDITOR_BUSY','NO_SAVED_BINGIE_PROFILE','UNVERIFIED_MENU_SHARING','HOME_ID_UNVERIFIED','INVALID_PROPERTIES','DUPLICATE_PROPERTIES','OCCUPIED_SLOT','UNSAFE_BACKUP_FOLDER','UNSAFE_TARGET','UNSAFE_PLAN','BACKUP_VERIFY_FAILED','TARGET_CHANGED_NO_OVERWRITE','TARGET_VERIFY_FAILED','CANDIDATE_VERIFY_FAILED','PROFILE_CHANGED','SKIN_CHANGED','UNVERIFIED_SKIN_FILE','UNVERIFIED_TEMPLATE','UNVERIFIED_OVERRIDES','UNVERIFIED_HERO_REGION','UNVERIFIED_FONTS','PLAN_BUSY'}


def runtime():
    import xbmc,xbmcaddon,xbmcgui,xbmcvfs
    if xbmc.getSkinDir()!='skin.titan.bingie.mod':raise ValueError('UNSUPPORTED_SKIN')
    skin=xbmcaddon.Addon('skin.titan.bingie.mod');shortcuts=xbmcaddon.Addon('script.skinshortcuts')
    if skin.getAddonInfo('version')!='2.2.3':raise ValueError('UNVERIFIED_SKIN_VERSION')
    if shortcuts.getAddonInfo('version')!='2.1.0':raise ValueError('UNVERIFIED_SHORTCUTS_VERSION')
    if xbmc.getCondVisibility('Player.HasMedia'):raise ValueError('PLAYER_ACTIVE')
    if xbmc.getCondVisibility('Window.IsVisible(script-skinshortcuts.xml)') or xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty('skinshortcuts-isrunning')=='True':raise ValueError('NATIVE_EDITOR_BUSY')
    return Path(xbmcvfs.translatePath('special://profile/')).resolve(),Path(skin.getAddonInfo('path')).resolve()


def rebuild():
    import xbmc,xbmcgui
    xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty('skinshortcuts-reloadmainmenu','True')
    # Same entry point as BINGIE 2.2.3 Home.xml. Native builder reloads only
    # after a successful build; never reset its hashes, settings or cache.
    xbmc.executebuiltin('RunScript(script.skinshortcuts,type=buildxml&mainmenuID=900&group=mainmenu|powermenu)')


def trace(event,kind='',slot=0):
    if event not in ('BINDING_SAVED','SKIN_PATCH_VERIFIED','RESTORED'):return
    import xbmc
    try:xbmc.log('[XCMate][WIDGET50] event='+event+' kind='+(kind if kind in ('live','vod','series') else 'skin')+' slot='+str(int(slot)),xbmc.LOGINFO)
    except (AttributeError,RuntimeError):pass


def error(exc):
    import xbmc,xbmcgui
    code=str(exc) if str(exc) in ERRORS else 'LOCAL_UNAVAILABLE'
    xbmcgui.Dialog().ok('XCMate',tr(36410,code))
    if code in ('NO_SAVED_BINGIE_PROFILE','HOME_ID_UNVERIFIED','SINGLE_WIDGET_HOME'):
        if xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno('XCMate',tr(36428),nolabel=tr(36426),yeslabel=tr(36429),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):
            runtime()
            xbmc.executebuiltin('RunScript(script.skinshortcuts,type=manage&group=mainmenu)')


def show(router,portal):
    if router._handle<0:
        import xbmc
        xbmc.executebuiltin('ActivateWindow(Videos,'+router.url(action='widget_setup',pid=portal['id'])+',return)');return
    import xbmcgui,xbmcplugin
    from menu_icons45 import icon
    from boot_diagnostics import finish_directory
    xbmcplugin.setContent(router._handle,'files');xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(router._handle,tr(32443))
    for label,kind in KINDS:
        item=xbmcgui.ListItem(tr(label));item.setProperty('IsPlayable','false')
        item.setInfo('video',dict(title=tr(label),plot=tr(36400)))
        image=icon({'live':'home_live','vod':'movies_home','series':'series_home'}[kind]);item.setArt(dict(icon=image,thumb=image))
        menus=[(tr(36401),'RunPlugin('+router.url(action='widget_skin50',pid=portal['id'])+')'),
               (tr(36402),'RunPlugin('+router.url(action='widget_restore50',pid=portal['id'])+')'),
               (tr(36303),'RunPlugin('+router.url(action='widget_manage49',pid=portal['id'])+')'),
               (tr(36403),'ActivateWindow(Videos,'+router.url(action='widget_sources49',pid=portal['id'])+',return)')]
        item.addContextMenuItems(menus)
        xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(router._handle,router.url(action='widget_link50',pid=portal['id'],kind=kind),item,isFolder=False)
    finish_directory(router,succeeded=True,cacheToDisc=False)


def link(router,portal):
    import xbmcgui
    from menu_icons45 import select
    from widget_binding50 import context,options,prepare,apply
    from widget_skin50 import applied
    try:
        profile,skin=runtime();kind=router._params.get('kind','')
        if kind not in ('live','vod','series'):raise ValueError('INVALID_SOURCE')
        if kind=='live' and not applied(skin):
            if xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno('XCMate',tr(36404),nolabel=tr(36426),yeslabel=tr(36401),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):skin_setup()
            return
        ctx=context(profile,skin);choices=options(ctx,kind,portal['id'])
        already=[v for v in choices if v['state']=='ALREADY_LINKED']
        if already:xbmcgui.Dialog().ok('XCMate',tr(36406,already[0]['slot']+1));return
        choices=[v for v in choices if v['state']!='ALREADY_LINKED']
        if not choices:xbmcgui.Dialog().ok('XCMate',tr(36407));return
        labels=[tr(36408,v['slot']+1)+(' · '+tr(36409) if v['state']=='UPGRADE_OWN_LIVE' else '') for v in choices]
        choice=select(xbmcgui.Dialog(),tr(36411),labels,default='grid')
        if not isinstance(choice,int) or not 0<=choice<len(choices):return
        label=tr(dict((kind,label) for label,kind in KINDS)[kind]);plan=prepare(ctx,kind,portal['id'],choices[choice]['slot'],label)
        if plan.get('code')=='ALREADY_LINKED':return
        entries=plan['entries'];message=tr(36412,label,choices[choice]['slot']+1,entries[0]['before'],entries[0]['after'])
        xbmcgui.Dialog().textviewer(tr(36411),message)
        if not xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno(tr(36413),tr(36427,label,choices[choice]['slot']+1),nolabel=tr(36426),yeslabel=tr(36414),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):return
        current_profile,current_skin=runtime()
        apply(plan['id'],current_profile,current_skin,confirmed=True)
        trace('BINDING_SAVED',kind,choices[choice]['slot']+1)
        rebuild();xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',tr(36415))
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,RuntimeError,ET.ParseError) as exc:error(exc)


def skin_setup():
    import xbmcgui
    from widget_skin50 import prepare,apply,applied,FILES
    try:
        profile,skin=runtime()
        if applied(skin):xbmcgui.Dialog().ok('XCMate',tr(36416));return
        plan=prepare(skin)
        hashes='\n'.join(name+'\n'+e['before']+' → '+e['after'] for name,e in zip(FILES,plan['entries']))
        from widget_skin60 import preview
        xbmcgui.Dialog().textviewer(tr(36401),tr(36417)+'\n\n'+hashes+'\n\n'+preview(plan))
        if not xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno(tr(36413),tr(36418),nolabel=tr(36426),yeslabel=tr(36419),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):return
        current_profile,current_skin=runtime()
        if current_profile!=profile or current_skin!=skin:raise ValueError('PROFILE_CHANGED')
        apply(plan['id'],skin,confirmed=True);trace('SKIN_PATCH_VERIFIED');rebuild();xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',tr(36415))
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,RuntimeError,ET.ParseError) as exc:error(exc)


def restore():
    import xbmcgui
    from menu_icons45 import select
    from widget_transaction50 import folder,load
    try:
        profile,skin=runtime();plans=[]
        for p in folder().iterdir():
            if not p.is_dir() or len(p.name)!=32:continue
            try:
                for kind in ('binding','skin'):
                    try:plan=load(p.name,kind)
                    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError):continue
                    status=json.loads((p/'state.json').read_text()).get('state')
                    if status in ('APPLIED','APPLYING','INTERRUPTED','RESTORING'):plans.append(plan)
                    break
            except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError):pass
        plans.sort(key=lambda p:p.get('at',0),reverse=True)
        labels=[tr(36421 if p['kind']=='skin' else 36420)+' · '+p['id'][:8] for p in plans]
        if not labels:xbmcgui.Dialog().ok('XCMate',tr(36422));return
        choice=select(xbmcgui.Dialog(),tr(36402),labels,default='shield')
        if not isinstance(choice,int) or not 0<=choice<len(plans):return
        plan=plans[choice]
        if not xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno(tr(36402),tr(36423),nolabel=tr(36426),yeslabel=tr(36424),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):return
        current_profile,current_skin=runtime()
        if current_profile!=profile or current_skin!=skin:raise ValueError('PROFILE_CHANGED')
        if plan['kind']=='binding':
            from widget_binding50 import apply
            apply(plan['id'],profile,skin,confirmed=True,restore=True)
        else:
            from widget_skin50 import apply
            apply(plan['id'],skin,confirmed=True,restore=True)
        trace('RESTORED');rebuild();xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',tr(36425))
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,RuntimeError,ET.ParseError) as exc:error(exc)

def skin_setup():
    import xbmcgui
    from widget_skin50 import prepare,apply,applied,FILES
    try:
        profile,skin=runtime()
        if applied(skin):
            # Never reapply or rebuild on opening this directory. Recovery of a
            # stale generated include is a separate, explicit user action.
            xbmcgui.Dialog().ok('XCMate',tr(36416))
            if xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno('XCMate',tr(36614),nolabel=tr(36426),yeslabel=tr(36615),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):
                current_profile,current_skin=runtime()
                if current_profile!=profile or current_skin!=skin:raise ValueError('PROFILE_CHANGED')
                rebuild();xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',tr(36415))
            return
        plan=prepare(skin)
        hashes='\n'.join(name+'\n'+e['before']+' → '+e['after'] for name,e in zip(FILES,plan['entries']))
        from widget_skin60 import preview
        xbmcgui.Dialog().textviewer(tr(36401),tr(36417)+'\n\n'+hashes+'\n\n'+preview(plan))
        if not xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno(tr(36413),tr(36418),nolabel=tr(36426),yeslabel=tr(36419),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):return

        if current_profile!=profile or current_skin!=skin:raise ValueError('PROFILE_CHANGED')

    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,RuntimeError,ET.ParseError) as exc:error(exc)


def restore():
    import xbmcgui
    from menu_icons45 import select
    from widget_transaction50 import folder,load
    try:
        profile,skin=runtime();plans=[]
        for p in folder().iterdir():
            if not p.is_dir() or len(p.name)!=32:continue
            try:
                for kind in ('binding','skin'):
                    try:plan=load(p.name,kind)
                    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError):continue
                    status=json.loads((p/'state.json').read_text()).get('state')
                    if status in ('APPLIED','APPLYING','INTERRUPTED','RESTORING'):plans.append(plan)
                    break
            except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError):pass
        plans.sort(key=lambda p:p.get('at',0),reverse=True)
        labels=[tr(36421 if p['kind']=='skin' else 36420)+' · '+p['id'][:8] for p in plans]
        if not labels:xbmcgui.Dialog().ok('XCMate',tr(36422));return
        choice=select(xbmcgui.Dialog(),tr(36402),labels,default='shield')
        if not isinstance(choice,int) or not 0<=choice<len(plans):return
        plan=plans[choice]
        if not xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno(tr(36402),tr(36423),nolabel=tr(36426),yeslabel=tr(36424),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):return
        current_profile,current_skin=runtime()
        if current_profile!=profile or current_skin!=skin:raise ValueError('PROFILE_CHANGED')
        if plan['kind']=='binding':
            from widget_binding50 import apply
            apply(plan['id'],profile,skin,confirmed=True,restore=True)
        else:
            from widget_skin50 import apply
            apply(plan['id'],skin,confirmed=True,restore=True)
        trace('RESTORED');rebuild();xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',tr(36425))
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,RuntimeError,ET.ParseError) as exc:error(exc)

import hashlib
import threading
import time

_lock = threading.Lock()
_cooldowns = {}
_test_lock = threading.Lock()
ATTRIBUTION = 'This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.'


def request(url, *, api=True, token='', cancel=lambda: False):
    from media_sources43 import get, SourceError, TMDB
    # This client never accepts a caller-selected origin or API-key query.
    from urllib.parse import urlsplit, parse_qs
    parsed = urlsplit(url)
    if not api or not url.startswith(TMDB + '/') or parsed.hostname != 'api.themoviedb.org' or parsed.username or parsed.password or parsed.fragment or 'api_key' in parse_qs(parsed.query):
        raise SourceError('UNSAFE_SOURCE')
    key = hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest()
    with _lock:
        prior = _cooldowns.get(key)
    if prior and time.monotonic() < prior[0]:
        raise SourceError(prior[1])
    try:
        return get(url, api=True, token=token, cancel=cancel)
    except SourceError as error:
        if error.code in ('HTTP_RATE_LIMIT', 'HTTP_AUTH'):
            with _lock:
                delay = max(300, min(86400, int(getattr(error, 'retry_after60', 300)))) if error.code == 'HTTP_RATE_LIMIT' else 60
                _cooldowns[key] = (time.monotonic() + delay, error.code)
                while len(_cooldowns) > 8:
                    _cooldowns.pop(next(iter(_cooldowns)))
        raise


def test_connection(cancel=lambda: False):
    from utils import setting
    from media_sources43 import SourceError, TMDB
    token = setting('tmdb_read_token43', '').strip()
    if not token:
        return 'TOKEN_MISSING'
    try:
        data = request(TMDB + '/configuration', token=token, cancel=cancel)
        images = data.get('images', {})
        if not isinstance(images, dict) or images.get('secure_base_url') != 'https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/' or not isinstance(images.get('backdrop_sizes'), list) or not images['backdrop_sizes']:
            return 'INVALID_RESPONSE'
        return 'TMDB_OK'
    except SourceError as error:
        return {'HTTP_AUTH': 'HTTP_AUTH', 'HTTP_RATE_LIMIT': 'HTTP_RATE_LIMIT', 'TIMEOUT': 'TIMEOUT',
                'INVALID_TOKEN': 'HTTP_AUTH', 'INVALID_JSON': 'INVALID_RESPONSE', 'CONTENT_TYPE': 'INVALID_RESPONSE',
                'CONTENT_ENCODING': 'INVALID_RESPONSE', 'RESPONSE_LIMIT': 'INVALID_RESPONSE', 'CANCELLED': 'CANCELLED'}.get(error.code, 'NETWORK_ERROR')
    except Exception:
        return 'INVALID_RESPONSE'


def launch():
    """HTTP in one daemon worker; all Kodi dialogs stay on their caller thread."""
    import xbmc
    import xbmcgui
    if not _test_lock.acquire(blocking=False):
        return
    progress = xbmcgui.DialogProgress()
    result = []
    cancelled = threading.Event()
    messages = {'TMDB_OK': 'TMDB-Verbindung erfolgreich. Authentifizierung und Antwort bestätigt.',
                'TOKEN_MISSING': 'Kein API Read Access Token hinterlegt. Unter Medien & Wiedergabe privat eintragen.',
                'HTTP_AUTH': 'Token ungültig oder Zugriff verweigert.', 'HTTP_RATE_LIMIT': 'Anfragelimit erreicht. Mindestens fünf Minuten warten.',
                'TIMEOUT': 'Zeitüberschreitung.', 'NETWORK_ERROR': 'DNS-, TLS- oder Netzwerkfehler.',
                'INVALID_RESPONSE': 'TMDB-Antwort nicht auswertbar.', 'CANCELLED': 'Abgebrochen.'}
    def worker():
        try:
            result.append(test_connection(cancelled.is_set))
        finally:
            _test_lock.release()
    started = False
    try:
        progress.create('TMDB-Verbindung testen', 'Eine begrenzte HTTPS-Anfrage …')
        threading.Thread(target=worker, name='XCMate-TMDB-test60', daemon=True).start()
        started = True
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 15
        monitor = xbmc.Monitor()
        while not result and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            if progress.iscanceled() or monitor.waitForAbort(.05):
                cancelled.set()
                return
        code = result[0] if result else 'TIMEOUT'
    finally:
        progress.close()
        if not started:
            _test_lock.release()
        cancelled.set()
    xbmcgui.Dialog().ok('TMDB · ' + code, messages[code] + '\n\n' + ATTRIBUTION)

msgid "Allow local staging and verified transfer for this destination? Requires space for the complete file. Interruptions preserve partials; retry copies the verified local file again. No automatic fallback to an internal destination. The non-atomic USB copy method may leave a visible incomplete destination file; XCMate never enables its playback. Local stages are retained for recovery."
msgstr "Für dieses Ziel lokale Zwischenablage und geprüfte Zielübertragung erlauben? Benötigt Platz für die ganze Datei. Unterbrechungen erhalten den Dateianteil; erneut versuchen kopiert die geprüfte lokale Datei neu. Keine automatische Rückkehr zum internen Ziel. Bei nicht-atomarem USB-Verfahren kann eine unvollständige Zieldatei sichtbar bleiben; XCMate gibt sie nicht zur Wiedergabe frei. Lokale Zwischenkopien bleiben zur Wiederherstellung erhalten."

msgctxt "#36306"
msgid "1. Open the desired home row in BINGIE widget configuration. Keep existing working rows. 2. For legacy folders, use the context menu Legacy widget source folders under XCMate > Settings > Appearance and display > Widgets, and open the source in BINGIE. 3. Choose Use as widget for the opened source and confirm the BINGIE configuration. BINGIE saves the binding; browsing XCMate alone does not save it."
msgstr "1. In der BINGIE-Widget-Konfiguration die gewünschte Startseitenreihe öffnen. Bestehende funktionierende Reihen beibehalten. 2. Für bisherige Quellordner unter XCMate > Einstellungen > Aussehen und Darstellung > Widgets das Kontextmenü Bisherige Widget-Quellordner nutzen und die Quelle in BINGIE öffnen. 3. Für den geöffneten Quellordner Als Widget verwenden wählen und die BINGIE-Konfiguration bestätigen. BINGIE speichert die Verknüpfung; das Durchstöbern von XCMate allein speichert sie noch nicht."

msgctxt "#36414"
msgid "Yes, save this binding"

msgctxt "#36415"
msgid "Saved and verified; native BINGIE rebuild requested. Home display still needs device acceptance."

msgctxt "#36417"
msgid "Review only: four known BINGIE 2.2.3 files receive the Home Hero/station strip and native widget candidates. Movie/series rendering, bindings and settings remain unchanged. Exact originals, candidates and rollback tests are saved privately. File checksums follow. Nothing has been applied yet."

After the separately approved Home patch, the direct XCMate candidates appear in its widget selector. No reset is needed."

msgctxt "#36510"
msgid "XCMate {0} is installed.\n\n• EPG manager: source comparison and live preview in the guide.\n• Automatic EPG updates every 24 hours by default, with readable reports.\n• Wizard: keep inputs and selected groups when errors occur.\n• Password remains available during Back and Retry in the current setup.\n\nAfter restarting Kodi, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and widgets are preserved."
msgstr "XCMate {0} ist installiert.\n\n• EPG-Manager: Quellenvergleich und Live-Vorschau im Raster.\n• EPG automatisch alle 24 Stunden als Standard, mit lesbaren Berichten.\n• Wizard: Eingaben und gewählte Gruppen bleiben bei Fehlern erhalten.\n• Das Passwort bleibt bei Zurück und Wiederholen in der laufenden Einrichtung erhalten.\n\nNach einem Kodi-Neustart muss ein nicht gespeichertes Passwort erneut eingegeben werden. Bestehende Portale und Widgets bleiben erhalten."

msgctxt "#36520"
msgid "Installation successful"
msgstr "Installation erfolgreich"

msgctxt "#36521"
msgid "Version {0}\n\nChanges:\n• Connection checked separately, with a clear success message.\n• Completed catalogue groups survive retries.\n• Portal saved before optional EPG imports.\n• EPG sources resume separately, with real progress and no total runtime limit.\n• New passwords remain editable during the running setup.\n• Clearer group counts and the regular XCMate background.\n\nAfter a new Kodi/Python session, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and settings are preserved."

msgctxt "#36306"
msgid "1. Open the desired home row in BINGIE widget configuration. Keep existing working rows. 2. For legacy folders, use the context menu Legacy widget source folders under XCMate > Settings > Appearance and display > Widgets, and open the source in BINGIE. 3. Für den geöffneten Quellordner Als Widget verwenden wählen und die BINGIE-Konfiguration bestätigen. BINGIE speichert die Verknüpfung; das Durchstöbern von XCMate allein speichert sie noch nicht."

msgctxt "#36414"
msgid "Yes, save this binding"

msgctxt "#36417"
msgid "Review only: four known BINGIE 2.2.3 files receive the Home Hero/station strip and native widget candidates. Movie/series rendering, bindings and settings remain unchanged. msgid "Apply only these four reviewed skin changes now? Verified backups remain available for rollback. The native BINGIE builder will rebuild Home; no reset or profile cleanup is performed. Cancel keeps the current skin intact."

msgctxt "#36510"
msgid "XCMate {0} is installed.\n\n• EPG manager: source comparison and live preview in the guide.\n• Automatic EPG updates every 24 hours by default, with readable reports.\n• Wizard: keep inputs and selected groups when errors occur.\n• Password remains available during Back and Retry in the current setup.\n\nAfter restarting Kodi, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and widgets are preserved."
msgstr "XCMate {0} ist installiert.\n\n• EPG-Manager: Quellenvergleich und Live-Vorschau im Raster.\n• EPG automatisch alle 24 Stunden als Standard, mit lesbaren Berichten.\n• Wizard: Eingaben und gewählte Gruppen bleiben bei Fehlern erhalten.\n• Das Passwort bleibt bei Zurück und Wiederholen in der laufenden Einrichtung erhalten.\n\nNach einem Kodi-Neustart muss ein nicht gespeichertes Passwort erneut eingegeben werden. Bestehende Portale und Widgets bleiben erhalten."

msgctxt "#36520"
msgid "Installation successful"
msgstr "Installation erfolgreich"

msgctxt "#36521"
msgid "Version {0}\n\nChanges:\n• Connection checked separately, with a clear success message.\n• Completed catalogue groups survive retries.\n• Portal saved before optional EPG imports.\n• EPG sources resume separately, with real progress and no total runtime limit.\n• New passwords remain editable during the running setup.\n• Clearer group counts and the regular XCMate background.\n\nAfter a new Kodi/Python session, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and settings are preserved."
msgstr "Version {0}\n\nÄnderungen:\n• Verbindung getrennt prüfen und Erfolg klar bestätigen.\n• Abgeschlossene Kataloggruppen bei Wiederholung erhalten.\n• Portal vor dem optionalen EPG-Import speichern.\n• EPG-Quellen einzeln fortsetzen, mit echtem Fortschritt und ohne Gesamtlaufzeitgrenze.\n• Neue Passwörter bleiben in der laufenden Einrichtung bearbeitbar.\n• Lesbare Gruppenzahlen und regulärer XCMate-Hintergrund.\n\nNach einer neuen Kodi-/Python-Sitzung muss ein ungespeichertes Passwort erneut eingegeben werden. Bestehende Portale und Einstellungen bleiben erhalten."
